scope: Offline feasibility of terminal diffusion-latent RGB moment guidance. Per-image targets are six unquantized donor statistics. No message decoder or key in this phase.
design: Pilot and repeat use the same 6 prompts and 2 new seeds each. Held-out test uses 32 different prompts with 2 different new seeds each, balanced COCO/SDP. Prompt selection is by hash before fitting. Arms share the actual 50-step DDIM output latent, same prompt, seed and donor.
target: Per experimental seed, take the full three normalized sRGB means and three population variances of an archived ordinary SD2.1 generation with the same prompt and another seed. Assign all donors before feedback. The two seeds for a prompt generally have different targets.
model: Manojb/stable-diffusion-2-1-base snapshot 0094d483a120f3f33dafbd187ea4aa60d10de75c, 512 square, half precision, DDIM 50 steps, CFG 7.5. Frozen parameters. Trunk and decoder use the local diffusers pipeline.
control: z' = z*(1+a) + bilinear_upsample(B), where a has 4 entries bounded by +/-0.5 and B is a 4x4x4 spatial bias bounded by +/-1. Both start at zero. The loss is evaluated on the VAE-decoded image in [0,1]. Mean loss has lambda_mu=2500 and lambda_var=0. Joint loss has lambda_var=2500 or 10000 in pilot. Solvers are Adam and damped Gauss-Newton using exact autograd Jacobian rows. Return the iterate with smallest loss.
tolerances: Final PNG: mean hit if every channel is within 0.02; joint hit additionally requires every channel variance within 0.01 (units are squared normalized intensities). Internal early stop uses 0.009 and 0.0045. All denominators include failures.
efficiency: Measure synchronized wall time on GPU. Each arm is charged the common trunk plus its own feedback and decoding, excluding file I/O and model initialization. Report time per image and time per observed joint hit.
quality: Raw text/image cosine and paired image/image cosine from CLIP ViT-L/14. LPIPS AlexNet to same-seed baseline and between two seeds per prompt. Exploratory 2048-d pool3 sample FID with exactly 256 separate real COCO test2017 images selected by hash, plus to the generated baseline. COCO-only reference-domain subset reported separately.
robustness: WAVES author distortion code: JPEG, Gaussian blur, normal noise at relative strength 0.4. ICCV 2023 Stable Signature author center crop at area 0.5 and resize at area 0.7. Save clean and edited moments, absolute drift, target and sibling-target hit at original fixed tolerances. Direct sibling-image collision and target-to-target collision are separate.
locations: All files from this experiment live in runs/rgb_moments_phase1_20261120 on 249 and experiments/rgb_moments_phase1_20261120 in Git. Full-size images, evaluation weights and 2048-d activations remain on 249.
